readme.note: Script variable reference demo. Four independent nodes (no need to run them in any particular order) show: current date/time, a node's own attributes (ctx.part), declaring new local variables in a script, reading the incoming packet (ctx.inputs), and folding new variables into the outgoing packet (the returned value). Step or Run Simulation, then watch the badges and the Message Log.

parts.label: DateTimeDemo
parts.description: Current date/time: plain JS Date() works inside a script, same as anywhere else.

parts.label: PartAttributesDemo
parts.description: Underlying part attributes: ctx.part gives you the node's own id/type/label/model.

parts.label: PacketEmitter
parts.description: New variables in a script, folded into the outgoing packet — the object you return as `value` becomes what PacketReceiver sees as its incoming packet next tick.

parts.label: PacketReceiver
parts.description: Content in the incoming packet: ctx.inputs[i].value is exactly what the upstream node returned as `value` last tick. This node reads it, adds its own new variable, and passes an enriched packet onward.
